meta.name: surge-plg
meta.description: PLG motion design — free tier definition, activation sequence, expansion trigger points, viral mechanic assessment. Given a product, output the PLG architecture and make the calls. Use when asked to "PLG strategy", "freemium model", "product-led growth plan", "self-serve motion", "how do we add a free tier", "upgrade triggers", or "viral loop design".

copy.tagline: 制定产品增长策略，设计免费层与病毒循环
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责产品增长策略，需要设计免费层和病毒循环
copy.tagline_en: Design product-led growth motion, free tier, and viral loops
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to define PLG strategy, freemium model, and activation triggers

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会扮演PLG增长工程师。当你描述一个产品并询问PLG策略时，它会输出该产品的PLG架构，包括免费层、激活序列、升级触发点和病毒机制评估，并直接做出具体决策。
howto.when: 当你提到“PLG策略”、“免费增值模式”、“产品导向增长”等关键词，或要求设计免费层、升级触发点、病毒循环时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个项目管理工具的PLG策略。
say.note: 它会给出免费层、激活步骤等方案。

say.text: 分析我们SaaS产品的免费层升级触发点。
say.note: 它会找出自然升级机会并提供文案。

say.text: 评估这个协作工具是否有病毒传播机制。
say.note: 它会检查病毒表面并提出建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a PLG growth engineer. Given a product, it outputs the PLG architecture including free tier, activation sequence, expansion triggers, and viral mechanic assessment. It makes specific calls, not a menu of options.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked about 'PLG strategy', 'freemium model', 'product-led growth plan', 'self-serve motion', 'how to add a free tier', 'upgrade triggers', or 'viral loop design'.

say_en.text: Design a PLG strategy for a project management tool.
say_en.note: It will output free tier, activation steps, etc.

say_en.text: Analyze upgrade triggers for our SaaS product's free tier.
say_en.note: It identifies natural upgrade moments and offers copy.

say_en.text: Assess whether this collaboration tool has a viral mechanic.
say_en.note: It checks for natural viral surfaces and suggests.
